note: Recommended Tower models per VRAM tier, capped at 14B dense plus one MoE. model id on the host = repo:quant; sizes are the GGUF file size. Listing rule: an entry has a thinking mode Tower's Thinking setting can switch, and `expected` is the median of three Tower checks (8 of 8 = high, 6 or 7 = good, fewer is not listed); `measured` records that median and its date.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.notes: Under the 7B line: expect the odd tool call written as text. Fits beside a working model on a small card.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B
models.notes: Small hybrid model with a thinking switch; the odd timer request written as text. Fits beside a working model on a small card.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.notes: Thinking model: give Answer length 2048 or more.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.notes: Gemma 4's small tier; fast first token. Thinking follows Tower's Thinking setting.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.notes: Hybrid thinking with native tool calls: the best pick at 8 GB. Give Answer length 2048 or more.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B (QAT)
models.notes: Google's own 4-bit build, trained for the quant: near Q6 quality at Q4 size.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B (Q6)
models.notes: The 9B at higher precision; the Q4 build scored the same on the Tower check.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B (Q6)
models.notes: The 12B at higher precision for a 16 GB card.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (MoE)
models.notes: Mixture of experts with 4B active: 26B knowledge at 4B speed. Fills most of a 24 GB card.
